description: This PHP class defines a dispatcher for named JMESPath functions, handling function invocation, validation, and various mathematical and data manipulation functions used within the JMESPath library.

classes.name: FnDispatcher
classes.description: A class for dispatching and executing named JMESPath functions, including validation and utility functions for data processing.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the FnDispatcher class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes a function based on its name with provided arguments.

methods.name: fn_abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

methods.name: fn_avg
methods.description: Calculates the average of an array of numbers.

methods.name: fn_ceil
methods.description: Returns the ceiling of a number.

methods.name: fn_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string or array contains a value.

methods.name: fn_ends_with
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: fn_floor
methods.description: Returns the floor of a number.

methods.name: fn_not_null
methods.description: Returns the first non-null value from arguments.

methods.name: fn_join
methods.description: Joins array elements into a string with a separator.

methods.name: fn_keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of an object.

methods.name: fn_length
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, array, or object.

methods.name: fn_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value from an array.

methods.name: fn_max_by

methods.name: fn_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value from an array.

methods.name: fn_min_by
methods.description: Returns the minimum element from an array based on a specified expression.

methods.name: fn_reverse
methods.description: Reverses an array or string.

methods.name: fn_sum

methods.name: fn_sort

methods.name: fn_sort_by

methods.name: fn_starts_with

methods.name: fn_type

methods.description: Converts a value to its string representation.

methods.name: fn_to_number
methods.description: Converts a value to a number if possible.

methods.description: Returns the values of an array or object.

methods.name: fn_to_array
methods.description: Converts a value to an array.
